angie_thread.email_body:
Hey,

I run One Body LDN and I'm reaching out because our Wimbledon clinic is the closest of our clinics to your Goldfinch office. We've got 43 locations across London. We treat a lot of people doing more or less your job, from KPMG, PwC and Deloitte among others. We fix backs, necks, shoulders, knees. Mostly from sitting.

I want to give you a 45-minute session with an HCPC-registered physio, completely on me. Proper hands-on treatment, and you'll know what's actually going on by the end of it.

Reply and I'll send you the booking code.

Kind regards
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

Hi Angie,

We're clinic-based, so you'd come to us rather than the other way round, but the good news is Wimbledon's basically walking distance from your office on Wharf Road. Most people in your building can get there in 20 minutes or so, and we're open until 8 PM most days, so it's easy to slip out from work.

Here's the booking link: https://onebodyldn.connect.tm3app.com/book/partnerships/physiotherapy_1/physiotherapy_assessment_treatment_45_min

Use VIP8401. Pick your time slot directly from the calendar when you book. There's a small £4.99 booking fee, which holds your time slot. Feel free to share the link and code with colleagues too, each person gets one free session.

Rebecca

angie_thread.email_body:
Hi Angie,

Sorry I was looking at the wrong location.  Let me give you the better options. Clerkenwell and Moorgate are all much closer to Wharf Road and will get you there in a couple of minutes. Moorgate especially has more options if you want to explore beyond physio. Same free 45-minute session:
Physio -> https://onebodyldn.connect.tm3app.com/book/partnerships/physiotherapy_1/physiotherapy_assessment_treatment_45_min

Sports Massage -> https://onebodyldn.connect.tm3app.com/book/partnerships/sports_massage_2/sports_massage_45_min 

Use VIP8401 and pick whichever clinic works best. 

Rebecca
